The primary safety concern is the Back Pressure Regulator (BPR) setting. Although the system is liquid-only, the presence of dissolved oxygen and the photochemical nature necessitates a robust pressure margin to prevent gas evolution or cavitation. The current BPR of 3.0 bar meets the minimum hard floor for gas-liquid systems (3.0 bar) and provides adequate margin over the calculated vapor pressure and pressure drop for both candidates. Material compatibility is confirmed for FEP tubing at 21°C. The main operational risks are mechanical (long coil length > 25m) and chemical (acetonitrile handling), which are manageable with standard PPE and coil management strategies.
